# AInvest

> > AInvest is an AI-powered financial analysis platform providing real-time stock quotes, market data, and cryptocurrency price analysis with advanced screening and forecasting tools.

AInvest combines artificial intelligence with financial market data to help investors make data-driven decisions across stocks, ETFs, and cryptocurrencies. The platform offers live quotes, AI-powered analysis, and screening tools for identifying investment opportunities.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered analysis
- Stock screener
- Real-time quotes
- Price forecasting
- Market data
- Cryptocurrency trading
- Stock picking
- Investment tools
- NASDAQ
- Ethereum
- Tether
- Binance
- Financial data
- Portfolio analysis
- Thematic investing

## Core Platform

- [AInvest: AI Stock Analysis, Quotes & News](https://www.ainvest.com): AInvest homepage with AI stock analysis, quotes, news, and portfolio tools
- [Free AI Stock Screener](https://www.ainvest.com/screener): AI-powered stock screener with advanced filters for data-driven stock picking
- [Market Overview: Stocks, ETFs, Crypto Prices](https://www.ainvest.com/market): Real-time market data dashboard for stocks, ETFs, and cryptocurrencies
